Schulz recommended setting clear expectations about the possibility of changes and staying proactive about managing them. He advised Li Hua to remind the clients that their constant changes could be exhausting for the project team but assured Li Hua of her capability to handle the situation by hanging in there and managing to keep the lines of communication open. Moreover, Schulz emphasized the importance of taking breaks to refresh one's mind and gain new perspectives, thus suggesting that Li Hua should not hesitate to take a break when necessary and use moments of clarity to continue progressing positively in managing client expectations.
